items: Chili's turnaround came from structural fixes: a shorter menu, more labor, new equipment, cleared maintenance and rebuilt training, which made consistent execution the default at every restaurant.
Most multi-location brands have never built the same kind of system for the digital guest relationship, so reviews, delivery complaints and messages pile up on overloaded managers.
Staffing every review and message with people rarely pays for itself at scale, and high turnover keeps resetting whatever process a brand does put in place.
The brands pulling ahead online change the operating model behind their feedback queue instead of asking teams to try harder or respond faster.
